blocks.text: Commercial expansion becomes more durable when it aligns with how people move: between homes, workplaces, schools, transportation hubs, services, and leisure destinations. In Iloilo, that pattern is becoming visible as population concentration, stronger output, and a widening base create room for enterprises closer to established demand. Western Visayas grew by 6.40 percent in 2025, accelerating from 4.40 percent in 2024, and posting the fastest growth among domestic economies. Gross regional domestic product reached PHP 683.44 billion at constant 2018 prices. The latest Provincial Product Accounts show that Iloilo generated PHP 218.86 billion in 2024, while the city recorded PHP 171.57 billion. […]...
